name: Al-Harith ibn Hilliza
bio: Al-Harith belonged to Yashkur, a branch of Bakr ibn Wa’il in the desert of Iraq. Literary tradition places the performance of his Mu‘allaqa at the court of Amr ibn Hind in al-Hira. He argued his people’s case against Taghlib by recalling their dealings with the king and the battles behind the dispute. The Mufaddaliyyat also preserves shorter work on travel, hunting and hospitality. Al-Zirikli dates his death to about 50 years before the Hijra (570 CE).
